eventos.texto: Línea reconocida: hay una ficha con ese teléfono
Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to cancel my appointment with Dr. Sayes.
Falta el nombre para buscar la ficha
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Laura Ruiz Gomez born the 14th of September 1978.
Ficha encontrada: Laura R. (por fecha de nacimiento y nombre)

Thank you, Laura, I have your record here. I can see general practice with Dr. Andrés Sáez on Monday the 28th of September at 9:30 am, and orthopaedics with Dra. Núria Ferrer on Friday the 2nd of October at 12 pm. Which one do you mean?
The one with Dr. Sayas, the GP.
So that's the general practice with Dr. Andrés Sáez on Monday the 28th of September at 9:30 am. Shall I cancel it?
That appointment is cancelled. Anything else I can do?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
